Before you spend a cent benchmarking AI coding agents against your Rails app, run the lemans harness's free `oracle` and `nop` agents first. No API key needed, and they tell you whether your test setup and verification checks are actually sound. Skip that step and you're paying to debug your own benchmark. https://go.fastruby.io/6j9 #Rails #AIAgents #SoftwareTesting
